title: Operations interview
text: Three recurring problems are delayed notifications, unclear ownership, and missing export history. Operations wants daily digest notifications at 09:00. Operations says a single named owner should be required for each task. No preference for the export file format was recorded.

title: Support interview
text: The recurring problems are delayed notifications, unclear ownership, and missing export history. Support wants immediate notifications for urgent tickets and a daily digest for routine tickets. Support agrees that a single named owner should be required for each task. Support prefers CSV exports.

title: Draft requiring source checks
text: Both teams report delayed notifications, unclear ownership, and missing export history. Both teams want only daily notifications for urgent tickets. Both teams prefer CSV exports. This draft has no citations.
